title: Data Literacy and Periodic Retesting in Academic Study
prompt: Some people argue that students in higher education should be required to take periodic retests of the same core skills, such as interpreting data and evaluating evidence, throughout their degree, rather than being assessed on these skills only once at the start. Others believe that repeating such tests wastes time and that students should instead be trusted to develop these abilities independently as their courses progress. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请先分别说明两种观点各自的理由（定期复测数据理解等核心技能的好处，以及认为重复测试浪费时间、应让学生自主发展的理由），再明确给出你自己的立场并加以论证。注意：不要只描述数据或罗列现象，要围绕论点展开论证，并用具体例子支持。全文不少于250词。
